# OSGi Utils

> A Java utility library that simplifies common OSGi tasks — bundle lifecycle tracking, configuration change monitoring, ranked service caching, bundle utilities, and reflection-based mock testing without a running container.

Key facts:
- Java 21 (compile) / Java 17 (runtime target), OSGi Core 6.0 / Compendium 6.0
- Maven multi-module project, 6 modules (3 code + 3 packaging)
- OSGi Declarative Services, Google Guava 30, Lombok, Apache Karaf 4.4.7
- Build with Maven Wrapper (`./mvnw clean install`)
- License: Apache License 2.0

## Docs

- [README.md](README.md): Project overview with architecture diagrams and build instructions
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): Developer guide with module details, build commands, technology stack, and coding conventions
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Contribution guidelines

## Modules — Core

- [osgi-api/pom.xml](osgi-api/pom.xml): Public API — interfaces (BundleTrackerManager, ConfigurationTrackerManager), utilities (BundleUtil, PropertiesUtil), service caches (ServiceCache, ServiceCacheByProperty), and data types
- [osgi-impl/pom.xml](osgi-impl/pom.xml): OSGi DS component implementations — BundleTrackerManagerImpl (synchronous bundle listener), ConfigurationTrackerManagerImpl (synchronous configuration listener), OsgiUtil
- [osgi-test/pom.xml](osgi-test/pom.xml): MockOsgi testing utility — activates/deactivates components and binds/unbinds @Reference dependencies via reflection without a running OSGi container

## Modules — Packaging

- [features/src/main/feature/feature.xml](features/src/main/feature/feature.xml): Karaf feature descriptor bundling osgi-api, osgi-impl with guava-30 and scr dependencies
- [kar/pom.xml](kar/pom.xml): Karaf KAR archive assembly for deployment
- [reports/pom.xml](reports/pom.xml): JaCoCo aggregate code coverage reports

## Depends on

- [karaf-features](../../packages/karaf-features): Apache Karaf feature descriptors for 20+ third-party libraries

## Used by

- [judo-meta-asm](../../models/judo-meta-asm): ASM metamodel — Ecore-based architecture model with builders and validation
- [judo-meta-esm](../../models/judo-meta-esm): ESM metamodel — business entities, operations, access points, and UI structures
- [judo-meta-expression](../../models/judo-meta-expression): Expression metamodel — type-safe numeric, string, temporal, and collection expressions
- [judo-meta-expression-asm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-asm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ASM for symbolic reference resolution
- [judo-meta-expression-esm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-esm): Bridges Expression metamodel with ESM for expression evaluation and validation
- [judo-meta-expression-psm](../../models/judo-meta-expression-psm): Bridges Expression metamodel with PSM for type resolution and measurement support
- [judo-meta-jcl](../../models/judo-meta-jcl): JCL metamodel — typed expression and statement DSL extending JQL
- [judo-meta-jql](../../models/judo-meta-jql): JQL metamodel — Xtext-based declarative query language
- [judo-meta-jsl](../../models/judo-meta-jsl): JSL language toolchain — grammar, parser, validator, code generator, and LSP servers
- [judo-meta-keycloak](../../models/judo-meta-keycloak): Keycloak IAM configuration metamodel
- [judo-meta-liquibase](../../models/judo-meta-liquibase): Liquibase database change management metamodel
- [judo-meta-measure](../../models/judo-meta-measure): SI units metamodel — measures, units, and conversion rates
- [judo-meta-openapi](../../models/judo-meta-openapi): OpenAPI 2.0 metamodel with bidirectional JSON/YAML transformation
- [judo-meta-psm](../../models/judo-meta-psm): PSM metamodel — foundational platform-specific data model
- [judo-meta-query](../../models/judo-meta-query): Query metamodel — expression-based RDBMS query generation
- [judo-meta-rdbms](../../models/judo-meta-rdbms): RDBMS schema metamodel with incremental evolution tracking
- [judo-meta-script](../../models/judo-meta-script): Script metamodel — typed scripting language with ASM/ESM adapters
- [judo-meta-ui](../../models/judo-meta-ui): UI metamodel — pages, containers, tables, inputs, and data bindings
- [judo-platform](../judo-platform): Model-driven OSGi runtime platform with REST APIs and Karaf deployment
- [judo-rdbms-schema](../judo-rdbms-schema): Incremental database schema migration via RDBMS model comparison
- [judo-services](../judo-services): OSGi runtime services enabling multiple data models in a single Karaf container
- [judo-tatami](../judo-tatami): Model transformation pipeline — ESM/PSM to deployable application artifacts
- [osgi-filestore](../osgi-filestore): Unified blob storage service with pluggable backends (RDBMS, filesystem, S3)
- [osgi-i18n](../osgi-i18n): Internationalization via JDK dynamic proxies and .properties files
- [osgi-validator](../osgi-validator): Hibernate Validator wrapped as OSGi Declarative Services component
- [solr-osgi](../solr-osgi): Embedded Apache Solr inside OSGi with dynamic core management
